description: This file defines multiple React functional components for UI elements, including Button, Input, Card, FAB, and EmptyState, along with their respective styles. It facilitates the UI rendering of a React Native application.

methods.name: Button
methods.description: A customizable button component supporting different variants and styles.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: A styled text input component supporting multiline input and custom styles.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A container component that wraps children with card styling.

methods.name: FAB
methods.description: A Floating Action Button component with customizable label and action.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: A component to display an empty state with title, optional subtitle, and an action button.
